snippet.title: Power Pointer - PlayStation 4 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Power Pointer is a charming arcade game where players manage a bustling apartment building by turning on lights in windows as residents return home.

Published by Phoenix Reborn Games
Also released for PlayStation 5

#ps4 #playstation4 #theforeseenarcade #powerpointer
